mechanism: Test whether a genuinely learned cross-task eight-byte latent permutation prior improves sourceblind full three-round composition reconstruction, using four publicly disclosed first-round 16-bit witnesses + forty noisy final FIT, fixed 32 equal swap proposals. TRAIN consists of independent one-swap mutations of a hidden shared ancestor, OPEN of independent two-swap mutations; hidden ancestor and per-task swaps never passed to fitting. Learned prior uses public TRAIN witnesses only, no direct family tags.
source: NEW synthetic TRAIN -36015..-36000; OPEN -36107..-36100, never consumed T11/T12 cases. Independently seed source per task. One shared latent relation yields in-family transfer only, explicitly not novel source-family OOD.
controls: Untrained identity-initialized 32-swap same-input and same-work; original T12 32-swap method as pinned; T3 general public fit; source-neutral exact outcomes, no private leakage. TRAIN amortized 8 OPEN and peak Python memory measured; remote public query cost separately incomplete.
acceptance: Strict OPEN correct improvement over strongest equal-work control with zero baseline-correct losses and whole-resource CPU/peak <= strongest. A positive limited to latent shared in-family; full scientific transfer requires independently frozen unseen family and replication. No protected MNS.
